# 1\. Executive Summary

This document defines Module 05 - Daily Leads for the AMR Coordinator Portal (iPOMS). It consolidates the requirements discussion covering the two daily registers - Positive Opportunities and Job Descriptions (JD) Received - into a single functional specification.

Daily Leads is a daily operational register, not a workflow: it exists to answer two questions every day - what positive opportunities did we receive today, and what JDs did we receive today. It is intentionally kept independent of the Daily Tracker (Module 03) and Weekly Tracker (Module 04), because it serves a different business purpose.

# 2\. Purpose

Daily Leads replaces the team's existing two-sheet Excel workbook (Positives and JD Received) with a single, fast, filterable module inside iPOMS. It answers two operational questions: what positive opportunities were generated today, and what Job Descriptions were received today, across all active colleges.

# 3\. Objectives

- Maintain a fast, manual daily record of positive opportunities and JDs received, independent of the Daily Tracker and Weekly Tracker.
- Keep the column structure identical across both tabs so data entry feels consistent regardless of which register is being used.
- Give Team Leaders, Administrators, and Training & Placement Officers read-only visibility without allowing edits.
- Provide Date and College filters so 15+ active colleges can be viewed through a single table rather than many separate ones.
- Preserve manual, timestamped entry, since positives and JDs arrive through calls, email, and WhatsApp at inconsistent times and should not be auto-synchronized.

# 4\. Module Position in iPOMS

Daily Leads sits alongside the Daily Tracker and Weekly Tracker in the sidebar, as its own module rather than a tab inside either of them.

- Dashboard
- User Management
- Master Company Database
- Daily Tracker
- Weekly Tracker
- Daily Leads
- Reports & Analytics
- Settings

| **Module**                 | **Tracks**                                                                                |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Daily Tracker (Module 03)  | Communication activities - calls made, call outcomes, remarks.                            |
| Weekly Tracker (Module 04) | The lifecycle of companies - pipeline, in progress, completed, rejected.                  |
| Daily Leads (Module 05)    | The positive opportunities generated each day and the Job Descriptions received each day. |

These are three different business processes; keeping them separate keeps the system cleaner and each register focused on one purpose.

# 5\. Who Can Access This Module

| **Role**                     | **Permission**           |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Placement Coordinator        | Full Add / Edit / Delete |
| Team Leader                  | Read Only                |
| Administrator                | Read Only                |
| Training & Placement Officer | Read Only                |

Only the Placement Coordinator can modify records; all other roles can view but never edit, matching the team's current process.

# 6\. Screen Layout - UI Design Decision

How the two registers, Positives and JD Received, should appear on screen was the single most-debated design decision in Module 05. Three options were considered.

## 6.1 Rejected Approach - Two Separate Buttons

The first option: two buttons, Positives and JD Received, each navigating to its own screen. Rejected - it feels like navigating between two pages, introduces a slight delay while switching, and does not feel like one module.

## 6.2 Rejected Approach - Two Tables Stacked on One Page

The second option: both tables displayed together on a single long page beneath a shared summary. Rejected - with 20-30 rows in each table the page becomes very long, requires excessive scrolling, and makes it difficult to focus on one dataset at a time.

## 6.3 Final Design - Excel-Style Tabs

Daily Leads uses two tabs, Positives and JD Received, inside one workspace - similar to Excel worksheets or browser tabs. Clicking a tab swaps the table content in place; the page never navigates anywhere.

- The active tab shows a colored underline (Infoziant theme) and slightly bolder text.
- Switching is instant - a smooth 150-250 ms transition, no page refresh, no loading spinner.
- The Date filter, College filter, and summary strip stay fixed above the tabs and apply to whichever tab is active.

## 6.4 Remembering the Last Active Tab

The module remembers which tab - Positives or JD Received - the user last worked in, and reopens to that tab on their next visit rather than always defaulting to Positives. This is a small usability improvement for coordinators who use the module every day.

# 7\. Daily Leads Screen Structure

## 7.1 Top Bar

The module title, "Daily Leads," together with a "+ Add Entry" action.

## 7.2 Filter Row

Date picker and College filter (All Colleges or a specific college), plus a Search field.

## 7.3 Summary Strip

Today's Positives, Today's JD Received, and Active Colleges, giving an immediate overview without opening a report.

## 7.4 Tab Bar

Positives and JD Received, styled as described in Section 6.3.

## 7.5 Table Area

Only one table is visible at a time, matching the currently selected tab.

# 8\. Tab 1 - Positives

Records every positive opportunity generated for the day, across all active colleges.

| **Column**     | **Description**                                    |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| S.No           | System-generated, sequential for the day.          |
| Time           | When the positive was attended or logged.          |
| Date           | The calendar date of the entry (see Section 10).   |
| Company        | The company associated with the positive response. |
| Role           | The role offered or discussed.                     |
| CTC            | The compensation offered or discussed.             |
| College        | The college the positive is associated with.       |
| Eligible Batch | The student batch eligible for this opportunity.   |

Fully editable by the Placement Coordinator; Team Leaders, Administrators, and Training & Placement Officers have read-only access.

# 9\. Tab 2 - JD Received

Records companies from whom the Job Description has actually been received - typically after an invitation email, a follow-up period, and a final confirmation (commonly around ten days after the initial request).

The column structure is intentionally identical to the Positives tab (Section 8), which keeps data entry consistent regardless of which register the coordinator is working in. The difference is the meaning of the data, not its shape.

# 10\. Date & Time Handling

Final decision: Time and Date are maintained as two separate columns in both tabs, rather than a single combined field. This holds regardless of whether the underlying date-time picker can capture both together, so that a JD received late at night against an email sent days earlier is always readable at a glance.

# 11\. Add Entry Workflow

Clicking + Add Entry opens a small popup that first asks which type of entry is being added:

- Positive
- JD Received

After selecting one, the corresponding entry form opens. This is simpler than maintaining two separate "Add" buttons for the two tabs.

Within the form, the coordinator may fill every field manually, or use the optional Copy from Daily Tracker shortcut:

- Add Row
- Copy From Daily Tracker
- Search Company
- Select
- Fields auto-filled
- Coordinator reviews and confirms
- Save

This shortcut is optional and does not remove manual control - it only reduces repetitive typing when a company has already been entered in the Daily Tracker. Pressing Enter or Save stores the row immediately in the active tab for that date.

# 12\. Filters & Summary Strip Behaviour

- The Date filter shows entries for the selected day only.
- The College filter shows either All Colleges or a single selected college; it works together with the Date filter.
- The summary strip (Today's Positives, Today's JD Received, Active Colleges) reflects the current filter context.
- Filters and the summary strip remain fixed while switching tabs; only the table content changes.

# 13\. Data Ownership - Created By (Audit Field)

Every record silently stores a Created By value (the entering coordinator's name or ID) in the backend. It is not necessarily shown as a visible table column, but is captured automatically for audit purposes - so that a question such as "who entered this JD?" can be answered immediately. This is distinct from a full edit history; it simply records ownership of the record at creation.

# 14\. Automation Policy - Why This Module Stays Manual

Positive opportunities and JDs arrive through multiple channels - calls, email, WhatsApp - at inconsistent times, and the timestamp itself is part of the coordinator's manual process. Automating entry would make the record less reliable, not more, since the system cannot always detect the moment a lead or JD actually arrived.

Decision: Daily Leads remains a manual operational register with fast entry, filtering, and export, rather than an automated sync from other modules or channels.

# 15\. Performance Requirements

This is treated as an explicit non-functional requirement, since many coordinators update Daily Leads throughout the day.

- Near-instant save operations.
- Smooth navigation between tabs, with no visible page refresh.
- Fast filtering by date and college.
- Multiple Placement Coordinators working simultaneously without conflicts.

# 16\. Toolbar & Export

Toolbar actions available on both tabs:

- Date Picker
- College Filter
- Search
- Export Excel
- Add Row

# 18\. Integration With Other Modules

- Daily Tracker (Module 03): source for the optional "Copy from Daily Tracker" shortcut when adding an entry - search, select, auto-fill, then confirm.
- Weekly Tracker (Module 04): conceptually adjacent but not connected - Daily Leads does not read from or feed into the Weekly Tracker automatically; each is maintained independently.
- Reports & Analytics (Module 06): consumes Daily Leads as a data source - positive responses and JD-received figures feed directly into Analytics KPIs, insights, and the Weekly and Monthly Placement Reports.

Architectural decision carried forward: Daily Leads is a manual register first, and a data source second - automation is never allowed to compromise the reliability of the manual record.

# 19\. Business Rules Summary

- Daily Leads is a separate, independent module - not merged into the Daily Tracker or Weekly Tracker.
- The module has two tabs, Positives and JD Received, sharing an identical column structure for consistent data entry.
- Only the Placement Coordinator can add, edit, or delete records; Team Leader, Administrator, and Training & Placement Officer have read-only access.
- Both Time and Date are captured as explicit, separate fields for every entry.
- Every record silently stores Created By for audit purposes; this is not necessarily visible in the UI.
- The module reopens to the user's last active tab rather than always defaulting to Positives.
- The Date filter, College filter, and summary strip remain fixed while switching tabs; only the table content changes.
- The "Copy from Daily Tracker" shortcut auto-fills fields but never removes the coordinator's ability to review and confirm before saving.
- Daily Leads is intentionally not automated - entries are always manually recorded to preserve reliability, since positives and JDs arrive through multiple channels at inconsistent times.

# 20\. Deferred / Out of Scope for v1.0

- Automatic synchronization of positives or JDs from the Daily Tracker, Weekly Tracker, email, or WhatsApp.
- A full edit/version history for individual records (Created By is captured; a complete change history is not part of v1.0).
- "Move" or "Pin to Top" row actions - not applicable, since records do not belong to different sections.
- Separate sidebar entries for Positives and JD Received - rejected in favor of a single Daily Leads module with tabs (Section 6).

# 21\. Conclusion

Module 05 is considered functionally complete (Business Design Version 1.0). Daily Leads gives Placement Coordinators a fast, familiar, Excel-style register for the two daily questions that matter most - what positives came in today, and what JDs were received today - while giving Team Leaders, Administrators, and Training & Placement Officers reliable read-only visibility, and feeding clean, timestamped data into Reports & Analytics.

# 22\. Next Module

Module 06 - Reports & Analytics: consumes the operational data captured across the Daily Tracker, Weekly Tracker, and Daily Leads to produce live analytics, insights, and branded, exportable reports for internal review and college-facing sharing.
